description: Draw the X-Matrix as an SVG picture for a deck or a report: the four bands, the correlation marks in the corners, the completeness score. Returns svg (the document), filename and mediaType. audience "internal" (default) draws everything with the KPI values; "external" leaves out the elements marked internal and every value and target, as a public page without figures. layout "initiatives" returns one page per initiative instead (its sheet: owner, why, expected result, milestones, next action, health, blockers), in pages; with audience "external" a page names nobody and leaves out blockers, the sentence behind the health, resources and the KPI value. Save the svg as a file; PowerPoint and Keynote insert it as is. For Google Slides, pass format "png": the pictures come back as images.

format.description: svg (default): the document as text, for PowerPoint and Keynote; png: the pictures as images, for Google Slides and anything else

lang.description: Language of the labels (default: the account language; English in local mode)

layout.description: matrix (default): the X-Matrix; initiatives: one page per initiative sheet

matrix_id.description: UUID of the matrix (default: the default matrix)

orientation.description: bottom (default): vision at the bottom, annual objectives left, initiatives on top, KPIs right, as most templates; top: vision on top, as the app

name: export_matrix_image
title: Export matrix image
